arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py.

## Case Selection

You can select specific cases to run using repeated `--case` flags. For example:

```
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --binary path/to/binary --repo path/to/repo --out path/to/output --provider openai --model model-name --case alpha --case gamma
```

This will run only the cases with IDs `alpha` and `gamma`, in the original suite order.

### Important notes:

- Repeated `--case` flags select each named case once, ignoring duplicates.
- Cases are always run in the original suite order defined in the test spec.
- If no `--case` flags are provided, all cases run by default.
- Unknown case IDs cause an immediate error before any output or execution.
- The output directory must not already exist to avoid overwriting previous results.

# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case selection

- Without `--case`, all cases run in their original suite order.
- With `--case`, only the specified case IDs are selected, in the order they appear in the suite; duplicates are ignored.
- Unknown case IDs cause an immediate error before any output is created or any case is executed.

Example selecting only alpha then gamma (order preserved):
```bash
scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py \
  --binary ./target/debug/coupled-pilot \
  --repo . \
  --out ./out-selected \
  --provider openai \
  --model gpt-4o-mini \
  --case alpha --case gamma
```

## Selecting cases with `--case`

Pass `--case <id>` once per case you want to run. For example:

```sh
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --case alpha --case gamma
```

Selection semantics:

- **Original suite order.** Selected cases always run in the order they appear in the
  suite fixture (`tests/fixtures/coupled-loop-v1.json`), regardless of the order the
  `--case` flags are given. `--case gamma --case alpha` runs `alpha` before `gamma`.
- **Duplicates run once.** Repeating a `--case` flag does not run the case twice;
  each named case is selected exactly once.
- **Unknown IDs fail fast.** If any `--case` value is not a known case ID, the pilot
  exits with an error before creating the output directory or executing any case.
- **No filter means everything.** Without any `--case` flag, every case in the suite
  runs, in suite order.

The pilot never overwrites an existing output directory; choose a fresh `--out`
directory for each run.
